title: Finish RA daemon cutover and delete eager direct-runtime leftovers
description: Follow-on work after the daemon cutover: internalize daemon-only surfaces, rewrite or delete eager direct-runtime tests/tools, and remove the last direct-runtime escape hatches.
design: This is a greenfield repo. There is no compatibility requirement for the eager direct runtime. Delete or rewrite leftover direct-runtime code instead of preserving it.
acceptance_criteria: Supported query execution is daemon-backed only; eager direct-runtime code paths are deleted; tests exercise the supported path instead of preserving old behavior.

title: Internalize WorkspaceService behind the daemon boundary
description: Stop re-exporting WorkspaceService from raql-host-ra at the public crate root. Make the daemon own the supported service boundary and move any remaining test access behind explicit internal test helpers.

title: Delete the eager direct runtime implementation from raql-host-ra
description: Delete the eager snapshot runtime from raql-host-ra after its remaining consumers are removed. This bead is the final implementation deletion, not a compatibility-preserving migration.

title: Rewrite repo smoke and corpus coverage for the supported runtime
description: Move crates/raql-host-ra/tests/repo_smoke.rs and crates/raql-host-ra/tests/conformance_corpus.rs onto the daemon-backed incremental path, or delete coverage that only exists to preserve eager direct-runtime behavior.

title: Delete or rewrite workspace_init eager-runtime assertions
description: Rewrite crates/raql-host-ra/tests/workspace_init.rs around supported daemon/runtime-service behavior and delete direct-runtime assertions that only preserve the old eager path.

title: Rewrite or delete extern runtime dispatch coverage for the supported path
description: Replace crates/raql-host-ra/tests/extern_runtime_dispatch.rs with supported daemon/runtime-service coverage, or delete assertions that only existed to exercise the eager direct runtime.

title: Delete the direct-runtime CLI path
description: Remove the eager direct-runtime entrypoint from raql-cli. Supported query execution is daemon-only, and this repo does not need a compatibility escape hatch.

title: Restore RA-backed stdlib primitive families
description: Rebuild the remaining stdlib extern surface on top of the daemon-backed incremental rust-analyzer runtime, with explicit capability registration and supported-path regression coverage.
design: Keep std.raql source-stable; add provider families under stable extern names; no public fallback to legacy eager snapshot behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Each restored stdlib extern family is served by the supported daemon/runtime path, registered in capability gating, and covered by daemon-path tests.

title: Restore the RA-backed call graph provider family
description: Implement call_edge/4 and dispatch_str/2 on the supported daemon/runtime path, with lazy extraction, capability registration, and regression coverage for direct, trait, dyn, closure, and fn-pointer dispatch where supported.

title: Add an RA-backed provider for stdlib search/3
description: Implement the supported daemon/runtime provider for search(Q, D, Score) using rust-analyzer-backed symbol/entity discovery, register the capability, and add daemon-path regression coverage.

title: Restore the RA-backed type surface provider family
description: Implement fn_error_type/2, fn_return_type/2, ty_app/2, ty_arg/3, ty_ref/3, ty_ptr/3, ty_tuple/3, ty_slice/2, ty_param/2, ty_prim/2, ty_unknown/1, and typeref_id/2 on the supported runtime with capability registration and daemon-path tests.

title: Restore the RA-backed reference-event provider family
description: Implement compares/4 and writes/3 on the supported daemon/runtime path using rust-analyzer-backed semantic/reference analysis, with capability registration and daemon-path regression tests.

title: Restore the RA-backed structure and trait provider family
description: Implement field/3, variant/3, method/2, trait_method/2, implements/3, and from_impl/3 on the supported daemon/runtime path, preserving stable stdlib names and adding capability-gated regression coverage.

title: Restore the RA-backed syntax-tree and control-context provider family
description: Implement node_at/2, node_kind/2, node_span/2, node_parent/2, enclosing_control/4, node_id/2, call_id/2, ref_id/2, and impl_id/2 on the supported daemon/runtime path, with lazy caching and daemon-path regression coverage.

title: Restore the RA-backed error-flow provider family
description: Implement constructs/4, propagates/3, converts/4, and handles/4 on the supported daemon/runtime path without falling back to eager snapshot behavior, then register the family in capability gating and cover it with daemon-path tests.
